For a 50-person Indian company, Trip.com is closer to an OTA than a fully managed Indian corporate-travel programme. The closest alternatives are:

Option	Current cost	Key exclusions / limitations	Best for
Trip.com / Trip.Biz	₹0 booking fee on domestic flights currently advertised; fare/taxes extra 
Trip.com
	No publicly stated India-specific corporate service fee; airline cancellation/change rules still apply 
Trip.com
	Teams prioritising international inventory and low upfront booking fees
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Custom service fee; shown separately on booking; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply 
MakeMyTrip
	GST invoices aren't assured for some airlines/international LCCs 
MakeMyTrip
	Indian SMBs wanting policy controls, GST and expense management
Yatra for Business	Custom quote	Exact service/transaction fees negotiated; enterprise features generally require onboarding	Companies wanting a managed travel desk and corporate support
EaseMyTrip EMTDesk	Custom quote	Pricing isn't publicly standardised	Companies wanting a dedicated travel manager, policy/expense controls and 24×7 support 
Travel Trade Journal
+1

Bottom line: For 50 employees, compare total booking fee + cancellation/change handling + credit terms, rather than headline airfare. myBiz and EMTDesk are more purpose-built for Indian corporate administration; Trip.com is more compelling if global flight inventory and low booking fees matter most.
